name: Triton
tagline: Neptune's captured moon — a Kuiper-belt world with nitrogen geysers, orbiting backwards.
history: Triton orbits Neptune backwards — the telltale sign of a captured Kuiper Belt object, a dwarf planet stolen rather than born in place. Voyager 2's only visit, in 1989, found a cantaloupe-rind surface of frozen nitrogen laced with dark geyser streaks where subsurface gas erupts 8 km high. Triton's orbit is decaying; in a few billion years it will cross the Roche limit and shatter into a brilliant ring.
